text:
morgan: quick heads-up — i sketched a tighter precommit burst tuning approach for Dedicated pools. want to sync on launch gating and oncall obligations.

.taylor: +1, need a clear SLA handoff. what counts as 'precommit' vs normal burst?

samira: i think precommit = explicit customer allocation that can still burst within soft limits for 10m windows. we should cap sustained usage to prevent tenant drift.

ben: can we add a short TTL for carryover credits? otherwise noisy tenants will hoard.

morgan: proposal summary:
- soft-burst band: short windows (<=10m) where reserved pool tenants can exceed baseline up to X qps
- spillover: after soft band, route to elastic lane or degrade to best-effort (no SLA)
- carryover: up to 5m credit that decays; admin toggle per-customer

riju: sounds reasonable. what metrics gate rollout?

jade: we need three signals for GA: 1) 95p latency within SLA under baseline+softburst, 2) spillover error rate < 0.5% for 1h, 3) billing export shows predictable unit economics.

morgan: + those. also oncall gating: if spillover causes >3% of reserved requests to route off-pool for >30m we pause rollout and auto-fallback to historic model.

ben: implementability note — autoscaler should support a tolerance window so transient bursts don't immediately scale. propose: smoothing window = 15s, scale-up policy requires sustained 3 samples.

samira: add a safety valve: when CPU/GPU headroom < 10% for pool, stop accepting soft-burst and surface immediate notif to owners.

jade: suggest a canary rollout: 10 customers, 2 regions, 2 weeks, with ops on standby for first 24h.

morgan: draft of autoscale snippet (for engineering):
```yaml
autoscale:
  smoothing_seconds: 15
  scale_up_threshold: 3 # samples
  max_precommit_burst: 1.8x
  soft_burst_window_seconds: 600
  carryover_seconds: 300
  headroom_safe_threshold_percent: 10
```

taylor: +1 on the snippet. ops wanted a human-in-loop escalation route — add a runbook step to notify pool-owner and offer fast-drain button.

deploy-bot: detected config flag candidate: `precommit_softburst_enabled` — suggestion: default off for new customers, opt-in for pilot.

morgan: agreed. rollout plan:
- phase 0: internal test with synthetic load (2 engineers) — target 3 days
- phase 1: pilot opt-in (10 customers) — 2 weeks, ops oncall 24/7 first 48h
- phase 2: region expand (all US regions) — 1 month, watch metrics
- phase 3: GA toggle default on for renewals, default off for new signups until 2nd month

riju: pricing note: we need clear billline for precommit burst units. finance: please model 3 pricing options (surcharge, included with tiers, or prepaid credits).

ben: engineering ask — please confirm required telemetry events: `burst_enter`, `burst_exit`, `spillover_route`, `carryover_consume`, `headroom_alert`.

samira: will add those events to the telemetry RFC. also add a per-tenant debug flag to rip logs for 1h.

jade: launch checklist items (short):
- telemetry + dashboards
- oncall runbook + fast-drain UI
- config flags + default off for new customers
- billing/legal language
- pilot opt-in signups + success criteria

morgan: decision points for product:
1) carryover policy: 5m decay vs no carryover -> prefer 5m for customer experience
2) headroom threshold: 10% vs 5% -> choose 10% to be conservative at launch
3) billing model: surcharge vs prepaid credits -> hold until finance models and pick pilot-friendly option

jade: we'll finalize 1 & 2 in this thread. finance loop for 3. ops to draft runbook by EOD Fri.

taylor: i'm happy to own pilot recruitment. can we create an opt-in signup page + terms?

morgan: awesome — assign owners: pilot recruitment = taylor, telemetry + events = samira, runbook = jade, autoscale impl = ben, finance modeling = riju. i'll drive product decision and coordinate launch comms.

samira: quick question — do we need a fallback model where we dynamically convert reserved to dedicated spot when pool overloaded? that feels risky.

morgan: let's avoid automatic reclassification at GA. prefer routing to elastic lane / best-effort. revisit after pilot.

taylor: noted. i'll start candidate customer list and ping legal for opt-in wording.

jade: ops will prototype the fast-drain button in staging tomorrow.

morgan: thanks all. action items posted. will update this thread with timeline and PR links. :thumbsup:
